title: Tree Serialization
description: Write a Zig program that serializes a binary tree into an array and deserializes it back.
hints: Use pre-order traversal: root, then left, then right
Use a sentinel value (-1) to represent null children
Pass idx as `*usize` (pointer) to mutate it in recursive calls
The serialized array can be used to reconstruct the tree later
